assembly-only.scope: Ablation: solve physical target while dropping inspection obligations.

astar-100.scope: Full transition model, static closure lower bound; 100 expansions per episode.

astar-1000.scope: Full transition model, static closure lower bound; 1,000 expansions per episode.

astar-500000.scope: Full transition model, static closure lower bound; 500,000 expansions per episode.

astar-hamming.scope: Same A* with occupancy + unfinished-audit lower bound; 500,000 expansions.

capacity-dispatch.scope: Resource-aware removal/inspection/staging rules; visited-state escape; no search.

legal-random.scope: Uniform current legal actions; no target-conditioned policy.

oracle.scope: Private exact product-state costs; software ceiling only.

relaxed-greedy.scope: Current legal actions + static closure Q; visited-state tie break; no search.

unlimited-rack.scope: Ablation: plan with unlimited rack, execute under actual capacity.

uncertainty: Seeds are tie-order repeats, not independent source samples. Report source-group and sampling splits; no population CI claimed.
